summary.gameLoopReview: Live code shows the core loop already has deep combat/debrief systems. The highest verified non-credential improvement this pass was making visible post-run coaching and score-submit outcomes measurable through tested system builders, without changing combat balance or adding paid cost.
summary.premiseVerification: DeathScreen rendered weapon mismatch and choke-point coaching while telemetry was assembled inline. App.submitScore also assembled analytics inline next to storage and leaderboard side effects. Both premises were verified in src/components/DeathScreen.jsx and src/App.jsx before implementation. Screenshot replacement remains real but requires browser scene capture beyond this code slice; Supabase/analytics deploy work remains credential-gated after check-secrets output reported missing capabilities. The innovation-pack replay candidate was narrowed to a truthful L1: explicit deterministic input-contract readiness, not a fake full resimulator.

candidates.title: Death coach telemetry truth
candidates.why: The DeathScreen already shows weapon mismatch, precision, enemy lab, cross-run pattern, and community choke-point coaching, but the debrief_intelligence event did not expose those visible surfaces as a stable tested contract. That makes feedback-loop analysis weaker exactly where the game is most differentiated: tactical post-run coaching.
candidates.recipe: Extract buildDeathCoachTelemetry() into src/systems/deathFlow.js, include visible coaching flags and compact choke-warning evidence, wire DeathScreen storage and track() calls through it, and prove the event shape in deathFlow tests.
candidates.evidence: src/systems/deathFlow.js exports buildDeathCoachTelemetry(); src/components/DeathScreen.jsx uses it for debrief_intelligence storage and PostHog track payloads; src/systems/deathFlow.test.js covers the visible coach surfaces. Focused tests pass 9/9 across deathFlow and runSession.

L2.recipe: Extract and test the event builder in the death-flow system.

candidates.title: Deterministic resim contract readiness
candidates.why: The innovation pack correctly keeps full deterministic replay resimulation as future work, but current code had no explicit readiness contract separating available seed/trace/submitted-score evidence from the existing heuristic pressure estimate. Without that contract, future work can overclaim deterministic parity or fail late on missing inputs.
candidates.recipe: Add buildDeterministicResimInputContract() to replayResim, expose it from runResim alongside the existing advisory result, and test both contract-ready and missing-input cases without changing the pressure-estimate gate.
candidates.evidence: src/utils/replayResim.js exports buildDeterministicResimInputContract(); runResim returns deterministicContract while method remains heuristic_pressure_estimate; src/utils/replayResim.test.js passes 6/6.

L1.recipe: Report whether deterministic resim inputs are present.

L2.recipe: Expose a tested input contract from runResim without changing advisory scoring.

L3.recipe: Build the first deterministic replay state-stepper using pure combat helpers.
